title: A test stand-in for an experts block inside captured rounds, over experts-reference
description: The package's experts-reference plugin with its device form run without reading the routes back to the host: each token's routes through the expert matrices gathered by the route ids on the device, one token at a time, summed in route order, the reference's arithmetic. For the round driver's tests of a mixture-of-experts model; experts-reference provides its own round form.
